description: Dismisses the flap alert (and the flap-monitor-down alert, since reaching 'off' proves the monitor is alive again) once no camera has been over its flap threshold for 30 min. Dismiss-only (no 'recovered' notification) - same churn-avoidance pattern as camera_health_recovered. The 30 min 'for' accounts for the ~1h rolling window decaying slowly after a storm ends.
